messages:
olivia: Quick poll: who wants to organize a 5-minute Paperclip Olympics next week? very low stakes, high chaos.
rahul: curious. what events?
casey: paperclip javelin, speed-fold, longest chain?
ojules: don't forget synchronized bending.
matt: i nominate paperclip relay (pass the clip without using hands).
olivia: rules draft: 1) each event 3 competitors, 2) finalists get tiny snack medals, 3) permissible equipment: only standard office paperclips.
casey: prize proposal: winner gets the Golden Binder Clip (temporarily).
rahul: are we doing heats during lunch or after 4pm?
ojules: lunchtime seems safer for morale. 12:30?
matt: 12:30 works. will bring a tiny podium (cardboard).
olivia: officiating committee: @casey head referee, @rahul scoreboard, @jules snack procurement.
casey: will enforce rules mercilessly. also will have a whistle.
rahul: i'll tally scores on a sticky note scoreboard. low-tech, peak vibes.
ojules: snacks: mini muffins and victory stickers.
snack-bot: Inventory check: mini muffins in stock (8). Would you like to reorder?
olivia: order yes if we need >8. otherwise fine.
matt: also thinking about a ceremonial slow-motion replay recorded on someone's phone. volunteers to film?
casey: i will film, but my commentary will be 100% dramatic.
rahul: idea: spectator category for best cheer. award: a sparkly sticker.
ojules: i craft the stickers. deadline: friday noon signups.
olivia: adding one culture clause: no clipping actual paperwork. disrespectful.
casey: enforceable.
matt: //posts sticker mockup: tiny paperclip wearing sunglasses//
rahul: love it. signing up: @rahul for paperclip javelin, @matt for relay, @casey for speed-fold.
ojules: signing up as wildcard.
olivia: perfect. official date: next Wednesday 12:30. may the best clip win. :medal:
snack-bot: :sparkles: Event "Paperclip Olympics" added to Office Lore (channel: #random).
casey: looking forward to bringing my A-game and my A-clip.
rahul: same. will craft a cheering chant. warning: it's awful.
ojules: it's tradition to be slightly embarrassed by our chants.
matt: agreed. see you at the podium.
olivia: closing thread. sign up on the whiteboard and bring competitive energy.
